svg.title: Records & graph · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: Graph points represent particular record versions. Connections represent existing relationships or declared local meanings. Separate histories supply a consistent recorded state for a selected graph view. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: The source record and the graph point representing it remain separate.
The graph connection preserves the specific relationship version, endpoints, required details and direction.
A represented subject binds to its applicable definition.
The selected ontology identity and configuration determine which representation and histories are used.
Each edge resolves its represented endpoint revisions.
The resulting meaning-bearing states of graph nodes and edges are preserved in recorded change events.
Governance records identify the exact meaning-changing event, its content fingerprint and its position in history.
Selected positions in the event history reconstruct one consistent meaning-bearing state.
The cut combines compatible recorded positions from the change and governance histories.
The view selects relevant information from the consistent recorded state for an identified user or task.
A selected graph view can contribute to the information prepared for a task. Each view has its own requirements.
Saved Project State supplies records and source versions for the task’s selected information.
